description: Ask anything: it searches, reads the best pages and writes a short answer with citations. ★ One of our best tools. Web search with a cited answer for AI agents (RAG), open-sources tier: finds pages via Wikipedia, Hacker News, DuckDuckGo and Stack Overflow, reads the top ones (robots.txt respected) and writes a concise cited answer, plus the pages read. q is your question; pages (1-5, default 3) is how many pages to read. Moves to full-web search (and price) when a premium index is connected. Use when you want a written answer with sources, not a list of links. Instead, use `search-open` ($0.002) for links only. Answers may be cached for up to 30 minutes. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits); failed calls are free. Paid only (not in the free trial). Try search-open free first.
